name: Impact frame
summary: Full-frame hit: the screen flashes inverted black and white with a radial burst; for big punchlines and hits.

params.name: count
params.note: number of rays, 8 to 60 (only even slots are drawn)

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different ray jitter

author: krakujs
